name: InsanitY
author: Serponge
description: Fall at 31% instead of clicking the blue orb. Navigate through the gameplay up to 36% by following the video. At 36.9% do a tight timing to go into the gravity portals and fall onto the floor without hitting the spikes. At 42% enter an invisible ball portal below the one you can see. Move to the floor at 43%. Click one more time at 56%. Stay at the ceiling to the end from there.
